{{BossList|Ref = Only the first '''Giant Skeleton''' in [[Badlands II]] is a [[Boss]] enemy.|Default}} }} ==Description== The '''Giant Skeleton''' is an enemy that appears in [[Badlands II]], [[Polluted Wasteland II]], [[Challenge Trials]] and [[Story Mode]]. It has a high amount of health and a below average speed. It is also immune to being stunned, only being slowed down, and immune to knockback from towers. The '''Giant Skeleton''' can be spawned by the [[Conjurer]] with its ''Summon'' ability, the [[Necromancer King]] with its ''Cursed Summon'' and the ''Nuclear Summon'' from the [[Nuclear Monster]]. ==Appearance== The '''Giant Skeleton''' is a larger version of the [[Skeleton]] with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and it has two large black eyeholes. On death, the '''Giant Skeleton''' falls into a pile of bones while playing a bone shaking sound. ==Strategy== *When dealing with the '''Giant Skeleton''' when it first debuts, high DPS towers are best fit. Such towers include the [[Pursuit]], [[Engineer]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]]. **Towers with large range, such as the [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] can be very useful here, as they can reach all three of the paths the '''Giant Skeleton''' will spawn in. **The [[Commander]] should be used to further boost the firerate of these towers. *Later on, '''Giant Skeletons''' will spawn in hordes. Splash damage towers, like the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] can deal lots of damage to these hordes. *Most slowing towers are on the table when it comes to slowing the '''Giant Skeleton''' down. The [[Cryomancer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] and [[Freezer]] are most effective due to the '''Giant Skeleton's''' tendency to spawn in hordes, while still being very effective against singular '''Giant Skeletons'''. **As the '''Giant Skeleton''' has [[Stun Immunity]], stunning towers like the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] will only slow it down. **As it has [[Stun Immunity]], it cannot be knocked back. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} GiantSkeletonWalk.gif|Walking animation (5 February 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1GiantSkeleton.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGiantSkeleton.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} KrampusRevengeGameThumbnail.png|'''Giant Skeleton''' on the game thumbnail.
